limits: Real desktop tests use an isolated synthetic installation and generated PCM media; no ML packages/models or audio-provider requests.
Busy decisions and queue-metric churn are simulated; owned process trees are real. GPU/provider inference and a fresh owner Windows11 installation are not requalified.
Shared Microsoft WebView2 Evergreen Runtime is required; startup explains a missing runtime before launching Python.
Original reviewed web interface runs inside the native WPF/WebView2 window; editors were not rewritten as WPF controls.
EXE remains unsigned/internal. Owner desktop review, first public release/signing and AMD research remain later.
